svg.text: Tricarboxylic acid cycle, classical respiratory complexes I-V, and plant-specific alternative bypasses
Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and respiratory electron transport chain. Substrates derived from the TCA cycle feed
electrons into classical Complex I (NADH DH) and Complex II (Succinate DH), as well as plant-specific rotenone-insensitive
external/internal NAD(P)H dehydrogenases (NDA, NDB). Electrons funnel through ubiquinone to either classical Complex III/IV
(generating a proton gradient for Complex V ATP synthase) or cyanide-resistant Alternative Oxidases (AOX1A/D), dissipating redox
pressure as heat without proton translocation.
